We attached the assertion sample and our signed W9 as requested. Can you triage with the integration/infra team? We need to be able to see PO visibility this week to avoid payment delays.

Ben / Laura — quick help needed. GreenPeak accepted the Workday invite but their Okta assertion (attached by vendor) doesn't include the vendor tenant id attribute we expect to bind to their supplier record. Symptoms: account created, but portal shows no linked POs.

What I think we should try:
- Ops: temporarily manual-attach the supplier profile to the existing GreenPeak vendor in the portal so they can see POs (stopgap).
- Security: confirm there is no risk attaching when SAML lacks org attribute (we still have W9 on file).
- Product/Integrations: confirm the exact SAML attribute name we ask for (vendor_id vs org_id vs custom:vendorTenant) and whether we can accept NameID plus email mapping as fallback.

Samantha / Oliver — we'll coordinate steps below. Leaving you on CC so you see the plan.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik — thanks for the heads up. Operational plan below (I will own the manual step if Security signs off):

1) Security check 
- Laura, can you confirm W9 receipt and that GreenPeak's domain (greenpeaksupplies.com) isn't on any high-risk list? If OK, we can proceed with a manual tenant attach to restore PO visibility.

2) Manual attach (stopgap) 
- I will create a supplier linkage ticket and attach the newly-created identity to the existing GreenPeak vendor record. This takes ~20–30 minutes and will re-surface POs immediately.

3) Long-term fix 
- Product: recommend we accept the common attribute names and add a fallback to map NameID+email to an existing vendor if attributes are missing. Ops can also provide a small diagnostic page for vendors to test their assertion before invite acceptance.

4) Postmortem owner
- Karthik, can you own follow-up with GreenPeak Okta admin to request the attribute update (we should provide the exact attribute name and sample assertion on our docs page)? I drafted a short note below you can paste.

Laura — W9 received? If yes, Ben will do manual attach and I will send the Okta request copy to Samantha.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reyes <samantha@greenpeaksupplies.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@greenpeaksupplies.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Workday invite — we can accept but no POs show up

Samantha / Oliver — quick update: Laura confirmed W9 received and no policy blocks. Ben completed the manual attach at 14:40 PT; you should now see historical POs in the portal. Can you verify?

For your IdP admin, please ask them to send one of the following attributes in the SAML assertion so future invites bind automatically: 
- Attribute name: vendor_tenant_id (preferred),
- fallback: org_id, or
- custom urn:oid:1.2.840.113556.1.4.7000 (if your IdP uses OIDs).

If they cannot add attributes, we can add a pre-accept diagnostic page to help vendors test their assertion before accepting the invite — we will work with Product on that timeline.

Samantha, I pasted a small copy you can send to your Okta admin: 

----- COPY START -----
Hi Okta team,
Our partner Redwood Inference requires a vendor-level attribute in the SAML assertion so our portal can associate the login with our existing supplier record. Please include one of the following in the assertion sent to https://supplier.redwood.ai/saml/consume:
- vendor_tenant_id (recommended)
- org_id
- or set the NameID to our vendor UUID and include email as auxiliary attribute

Sample attr mapping in Okta:
attribute name: vendor_tenant_id -> user.vendorTenantId

Thanks,
Samantha
----- COPY END -----

Oliver — let me know once you confirm PO visibility and I'll close the ticket. If anything still looks off, we'll escalate to Product for the fallback mapping.

—Karthik
